title: Bounding the integral over W from a bound on a measurable subset V and |g| ≤ 1
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let μ be a measure on the Borel σ-algebra of ℝ^P, and let g : ℝ^P → ℝ be μ-a.e. strongly measurable with |g(x)| ≤ 1 for μ-a.e. x. Let θ ∈ ℝ, and let V ⊆ W ⊆ ℝ^P with V measurable, W arbitrary and μ(W) < ∞. If ∫_V g dμ ≤ θ·μ(V), then ∫_W g dμ ≤ μ(W) − (1 − θ)·μ(V). All measures are read as real numbers via ENNReal.toReal, and set integrals are taken with respect to the restricted measure μ⌞S (μ.restrict S).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) (V W : Set (Euclid P)), AEStronglyMeasurable g μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, |g x| ≤ 1) → MeasurableSet V → V ⊆ W → μ W < ∞ → ∫ y in V, g y ∂μ ≤ θ * (μ V).toReal → ∫ y in W, g y ∂μ ≤ (μ W).toReal - (1 - θ) * (μ V).toReal
